description: Privileged Zoho Mail API client (alpha: in-memory access token, nothing persisted) plus native junk-marking. Unofficial; not affiliated with Zoho.

functions.name: setConnection
functions.description: Hold an access token in memory for a data center ('com', 'eu', 'in', 'com.au', 'com.cn'). In-memory only in the alpha.

functions.name: connectionStatus
functions.description: Returns { connected, dc, expiresAt } without exposing the token.

functions.name: report
functions.description: Find the Zoho messageId matching the given message details, then PUT updatemessage mode=moveToSpam. Returns { ok, messageId?, error? }.

functions.name: markJunkSelected
functions.description: Mark the currently selected message junk in the most recent 3-pane window, inheriting the user's junk settings. Returns { ok, method?, error? }.
